games.title: Hiral's requests (27 Oct)
games.verdict: Requests from Hiral on 27 Oct 2026. The Education Planner change is her stated priority. A tested draft exists (audits/games-2026-10-26/drafts/education-planner-per-child.html) but nothing is live.

items.text: Education Planner: let each child have their own expected SIP return, instead of one rate applied to all children. Children of different ages need different assumptions.
Education Planner: let each child have their own existing investments (amount, return %, amount still being added each month), instead of one shared pot for all children.

Education Planner: show, for each child, the monthly SIP (from now until that child's education starts) AND the one-time lump sum needed today to bridge that child's funding gap, plus a family total. Today there's one SIP figure, timed to the eldest child.
Move the Dividend Income Planner out of the games list and into a separate Resources / Tools tab.
Move Asset Allocation out of the games list and into the Resources / Tools tab.
Remove the Financial Goal Planner from the listings (Fund YOUR Goal and Goal Tracker already cover it).

games.title: Structure decisions (27 Oct)
games.verdict: From the structure discussion on 27 Oct. Course material and never-launched beta games went public on the All games page on 16 Oct. Until then the classic hub had kept them hidden behind admin mode.

items.text: Take the 'Courses & Beta' section (Investopia, Investopia 2, IFM Course, IFM Course 2, Chat Bot, News Agency) off the public All games page. The classic hub kept these hidden behind admin mode; the 16 Oct All games page made them public by mistake.
Stop Google from listing the course module pages (/module-1 to /module-6): mark them 'noindex' and keep them out of every public listing.

Take the never-launched beta games (Rollercoaster, Mix My Portfolio, ChaiBoss, Timing Trap, Market Madness 1, Dividend or Dash, Fair or Fleeced) off the public All games page until the beta deep-dive decides keep / fix / retire for each.
Beta deep-dive: one decision card per beta game and classic-hub tool (what it is, screenshot, audit verdict, any usage), so we decide keep / fix / merge / retire for each.

Give the classroom games a 'play on your own' mode (against computer players), like The Wealth Hack's solo page. 336 quiz rooms, 75 Broke by Friday rooms and 45 MF Manager rooms were opened and never joined by anyone.
Re-check in 2–3 weeks, using PostHog's game_started events, whether visitors play the classroom games on their own. PostHog has only been on the games site since 22 Oct.
